summary: Anderson County, TX Texas Forest Service tower named in a January 1993 notice offering towers for sale and dismantling; the Texas index lists it gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no removal date or site description found

events.note: Texas Forest Service notice dated January 15, 1993 invited sealed bids for the sale, dismantling and removal of its fire lookout towers, naming the Elkhart tower; bids due February 23, 1993. The result of the sale is not in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the 1993 sale notice (a Forest Lookouts clipping of the Tyler Morning Telegraph) and the Texas index. No build date, staffing, fires, removal date or site description found after 2 WebSearch calls and about 3 page reads. The Montalba page carries a notice of the same date for a different Anderson County tower, so the sale notice looks like a series; this is not stated in the Elkhart story. The story runs under the 120-word floor because the sources say no more; it was not padded. The coordinates are from the index and were not checked against a map.
